comparison.objective: Join duct sections and install drive cleats on both sides versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-sheet alignment and extended cleat insertion/driving versus small-tool insertion, fine collar adjustment, locking, and dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Both duct sides must be joined and cleated; candidate requires two constrained physical stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Assembly and seam locking do not test iterative damping control. Joint-fit, cleat-depth, and damage thresholds are unavailable.
